messages:
Alex: Quick sync — Cobalt is targeting the Dedicated->Private handoff next Wed. Can we lock a 30m readiness/readout to walk through network peering, certs/KMS, runbook, and smoke tests? Prefer 9–11am PT. I'll draft an agenda here.

Ben: +1. 10:00am PT works for me. Who else needs to be on the call? @Carla for infra, @Priya for SRE, @Dave for support.

Carla: 10:00 PT is fine. Please include a 15m slot for a dry-run of VPC peering and route table checks — that historically eats time.

Priya: I can make 10. Quick ask: can CS share the customer VPN creds and a test IP by EOD Monday? I need that to validate smoke tests ahead of time.

Alex: Good point. I'll ping CS after this thread. Tentative agenda: 
- 5m: intros & current status
- 15m: VPC peering dry-run (Carla)
- 5m: certs/KMS handover + access checks (Alex/Priya)
- 5m: smoke tests + rollback plan (Dave/Priya)
- 5m: routing policies + fallback model variant check (Ben)
- 5m: open Q&A / next steps

Ben: Can we also confirm model variant compatibility (quantization/latency) as part of the fallback discussion? 5m should be fine for the high-level.

Dave: I'll own the smoke tests. I'll push the basic harness to the infra-runbooks repo under `cobalt/smoke` and link it here before the call.

Carla: Sample VPC checklist I'll run through:
```
# VPC peering quick check
- verify route table has route to customer CIDR (10.42.0.0/16)
- security groups allow 8080/443 between subnets
- run `nc -z customer-ip 8080` from a bastion
```
I'll paste full commands in the doc.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Cobalt deployment readiness" — Wed Mar 25 2026 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Attendees: Alex, Ben, Carla, Priya, Dave, Cobalt-ops. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcdef

Priya: Pre-call checklist I'll publish by Mon EOD: firewall rules, KMS key access test, ingress certs presence, and test user creds. Will add a small playbook for handoff validation.

Alex: Assignments: Carla -> network dry-run & commands; Priya -> checksheet + KMS cert checks; Ben -> routing/fallback & model variant note; Dave -> smoke test harness; CS -> share VPN creds & contact.

Ben: Also: let's record the session and capture runbook edits as a PR to infra-runbooks so nothing is lost. :movie_camera:

Alex: Agreed. I'll record and open the PR after the call.

Carla: If peering fails, can we reserve a 15-min slot immediately after the main call for troubleshooting? Same calendar invite would be ideal.

Cobalt-Ops: (external) Thanks — we'll send VPN creds, test IP, and a dedicated contact in this slack by EOD Mon. We'll be on the call at 10:00 PT and can do the extra follow-up if needed.

Alex: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the event description with the runbook link and the final agenda once the creds arrive. Ping here for any blockers. :thumbsup:
